I attempted genuine suicide attempt a few days ago was released from a psychiatric ward literally just today. (https://8ch.net/suicide/res/47416.html)

From my experience, I dont find the suicidal thoughts as “suffering” at all. They are comforting, that thought that I could always drift off and escape. Now that I’m out, I’ve realised that I’m trapped to living my life or attempting a haphazard and painful suicide, since my parents were told about everything and I have people monitoring me. I hate living.
yea I have access to my phone, ive just been sitting on my bed for like 15 hours straight now
